limitations: Equivalent constant-return obligations cover a shared semantic fragment, not general theorem-prover equivalence.
No OS page-cache eviction is attempted. Process-cold and live-server warm timings are separate.

Solver time/resource limits differ in meaning between Z3 and kernel-checked Lean; total client deadlines are shared.
Frontend, VC generation and solver phases remain unmeasured unless supplied by native notifications.
Dafny protocol recording adds synchronous disk writes in the extension host; use --trace off for an observer-overhead control.
Missing editor capabilities and incomplete scenarios prevent a claim of full parity.

interpretation: The paired workloads use 4 constant-return functions; the incremental case adds one function.
Fresh process/profile startup and live-server incremental verification are separate. OS caches were not flushed.
The local backend does not apply worker/cache settings. Its repeated configurations are controls, not local scaling.
Solver overlap is derived from distinct process CPU deltas, not task counts or async calls.
Dafny owns a Boogie engine per project; Boogie 3.5.5 applies VcsCores using a per-engine semaphore. Requested workers are not a global server-wide solver cap.
Cancellation remains acknowledgement-only; complex proofs, renderer paint latency and single-declaration assertion-split scaling remain unexamined.
Three measurement repetitions give descriptive medians and nearest-rank p95, not a stable tail-latency estimate.
